content.rendered:
PAY ATTENTION TO GOD

“3. …there shall meet thee three men going up to God to Bethel, one carrying three kids, and another carrying three loaves of bread, and another carrying a bottle of wine: 4. And they will salute thee, and give thee two loaves of bread…”
(1 Samuel 10: 3-4)

That is the Focal Scripture of Streams of Joy Devotional today.

In our Focal Scripture, Prophet Samuel spoke of three men who would be going up to God in Bethel. Bethel was the place of worship. These men were on their way to the temple; their mission was to worship God. Their attention was on God; their movement was all about God; they were God chasers.

The men who were on their way to the temple had three kids, a bottle of wine and three loaves of bread. They later gave two loaves of bread to Saul. They focused on God, and they had what a king needed. They paid attention to God, and they had resources that their generation was in need of.

Friend, in this year, pay attention to God. Be a God chaser; run towards God; let your focus and commitment be towards God; let your hope be in God; let your heart be stayed on God; let God be the center of your being and your existence; let God be your foremost priority; let God be your destination.

Men whose destination is God’s house and whose priority is God always have what their generation needs. God chasers always have ideas that turn things around in their environment. If you become a God chaser, God will load you with benefits that will be beneficial to your generation; when you become a God chaser, God will give you resources that kings need.

Stop chasing opportunities to serve the kings of this world; just become a God chaser, make God your high priority, keep running towards God, and He will endue you with what your generation needs.

Pray With Me: Lord, You are my priority this year; I have what my generation needs, in Jesus’ name!
